title: SubagentProgressEvent
description: Structured progress event emitted by IBM Bob 2.0 subagents over the IPC wire protocol.

event_id.description: Unique UUID v4 identifier for this event.

subagent_id.description: Identifier of the emitting subagent worker.

phase.description: Current execution phase of the subagent.

target_file.description: Relative path to the file currently being analyzed.

line_offset.description: 1-based line number of the AST node being analyzed.

column_offset.description: 0-based column offset of the AST node.

ast_node_type.description: Tree-sitter node type identifier (e.g. call_expression, select_statement).

ast_symbol_name.description: Resolved symbol name if available (function name, field name, etc.).

status_message.description: Human-readable status message from the subagent.
